Description

Play on a high-quality 3G full-size pitch suitable for 11-a-side football at City of London Academy Southwark, located in the heart of Southwark, London. The pitch features a modern artificial surface designed for consistent play in all weather conditions, making it ideal for matches, training sessions, and league fixtures.

The venue is easily accessible by public transport, with Bermondsey Underground Station just a short walk away, offering excellent links across London. Local amenities and secure surroundings make this a convenient and reliable choice for teams of all levels.

Perfect for competitive fixtures, casual games, and organised football events, the pitch is available for both single and repeat bookings.
